hero.heading: An evening dressed in gold
hero.intro: The Sankofa Royale gala is a fundraising celebration in the grand tradition: a red carpet, live local artists, African cuisine and a ceremony that puts our community's achievers in the spotlight.

intro.heading: More than an awards show
intro.body:
The evening brings together honourees, their families, community and faith leaders, entrepreneurs, elected officials and friends of CAWAP. It is a night to dress in your finest traditional attire, to applaud people who rarely ask for applause, and to invest — through every ticket and contribution — in the programs that keep families fed, youth engaged and women empowered.

Guests are warmly invited to contribute to the project and its future work. Every gift goes further than one night.

moments.title: Limousines & the red carpet
moments.text: Honourees and guests are welcomed at the door and step onto the red carpet, where photographers and videographers capture every entrance.

moments.title: Reception & seating
moments.text: Guests are seated at tables dressed in black and gold. Hosts open the evening and introduce the theme of the year.

moments.title: A taste of the continent
moments.text: An African dining experience, from the single-ticket table to the VVIP and Platinum tables with fine wine and premium pairings.

moments.title: The Sankofa Royale Awards
moments.text: Category by category, honourees are called to the stage to receive their award and certificate before the community.

moments.title: Performances & dancing
moments.text: Live local artists, music and dancing carry the evening late into the night — with plenty of time for photos.

items.label: Dress code
items.value: Formal traditional attire — wear your heritage proudly. Black tie is also welcome.

items.label: Time
items.value: Doors from 5:00 PM; the celebration runs until midnight.

items.label: Photos
items.value: A paparazzi-style photo experience is included for nominees and guests.

items.label: Contributions
items.value: Guests may contribute to support CAWAP's community programs.

attire.heading: The royal dress code
attire.body: Kente, aso-oke, agbada, boubou, kitenge, sari-inspired silks, sharp tuxedos — the Sankofa Royale red carpet is a celebration of the diaspora's style. Come as royalty.
